sam: quick heads-up: rolling kernel v2.16.0 + quant qf-2026-07 tonight 02:00 UTC. plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m holds. auto-pin if 5xx >0.3% for 4m. cross-region requires marta ok.

deploybot: preflight scheduled 01:30 UTC; will run prebake+smoke; /status for updates.

marta: noted. primary risk is kv write ordering on long sequences. SRE will watch p99, 5xx, and kv-miss.

jon: rollback command ready: `/deploy rollback deploy-5234567890 --reason "health gate breach"`. Also pre-created tenant-pin quick CLI.

deploybot: preflight PASS 01:32 UTC. checksum ok. canary 0.5% starting 02:00:05 UTC. link: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5234567890

marta: checking telemetry. initial p99 +2.5%, 5xx flat, kv-miss +0.02%. clear to go to 5% after hold.

ops: watching evictions and OOM. prepared sticky pin TTL=2h if needed.

deploybot: promoted to 5% 02:06:10 UTC. holding 5m.

marta: no gate breaches. approving 25% at 02:12 UTC.

sam: promoting now. if anyone sees 5xx spikes, run the rollback command or set manual pin: `deploybot pin set --id deploy-5234567890 --ttl 2h --scope region-all`.

deploybot: final promote to 100% completed 02:25:10 UTC. summary: no auto-pins, no rollbacks. RN will be posted to #release-notes."
